title: The Year Nothing Happened
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：year　|　正文 313 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 year 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① year I remember best is 1961, and I was eleven, and I have never been able to say why, and my mother says the reason is that nothing happened in it. For ② years afterwards she said the same thing about every year, and I have come to think it was not a judgement on the years but on herself.

She was forty-one ③ years old in 1961 and looked older, and my grandmother said she had been born old, which my mother repeated for thirty-one years as if it were a compliment, and no year, she said, ever improves a person.

In those ④ years, meaning the eleven between 1961 and 1972, the village lost its shop, its school and eleven of its young people, and my mother said the last was the only one anybody noticed. The shop closed in 1965 and the school in 1968, and she marked both in the same book.

The ⑤ school year began in September and ended in July, and she was absent for eleven weeks of it in 1963, never caught up and never said so. It took ⑥ a year to get the roof mended and eleven to get the road, and she said the difference was that the roof was hers, and the roof, when it was finished, leaked for another eleven years, and the year was the longest of her life.

⑦ All year round she was up at five, and ⑧ year after year she said she would stop, and she never did, and my father said the saying of it was the point and not the doing. The ⑨ year she did not get up at five was 1998, and she was eighty-one. The ⑩ year, meaning the thing itself and not any particular one, is what she cared about, and she said once that a year is long enough for anything and short enough for nothing.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 一年（时间长度）
C. n. 年纪；岁数（years old）
E. n. （复数）年代；那些年月
F. n. （复数）多年；很长时间（for years）
G. 固定搭配：all year round 一年到头；终年
H. 固定搭配：year after year 年复一年；年年

items.q: The year I remember best is 1961
She was forty-one years old in 1961
In those years, meaning the eleven
The school year began in September
It took a year to get the roof
All year round she was up at five
year after year she said she would stop
The year she did not get up at five
The year, meaning the thing itself

answers.why: the year 意为“年、年份”，我记得最清楚的一年是 1961 年，那年我十一岁。
for years 意为“多年、很长时间”，此后很多年里，她对每一年都是这么说的。
years old 意为“……岁、年纪”，1961 年她四十一岁，看上去更老。
in those years 意为“在那些年月里、那个年代”，指 1961 到 1972 年之间的十一年。
the school year 意为“学年”，学年从九月开始，到七月结束。
a year 意为“一年（的时间长度）”，修屋顶花了整整一年，修路花了十一年。
all year round 意为“一年到头、终年”，她一年到头都五点起床。
year after year 意为“年复一年、年年”，她年年都说要停下来，却从来没有停过。
the year 意为“（那一个）年份”，她没有五点起床的那一年是 1998 年，那年她八十一岁。
the year 意为“年（这件事本身）”，她在意的是“一年”本身，而不是某具体的一年。
